title: Configuration Option for Global Thinking Mode Toggle
body:
**Bug Description**
I think there should be a configuration option to enable or disable the thinking mode all at once, instead of having to add "please think deeply" every time I need it.

**Environment Info**
- Platform: darwin
- Terminal: cursor
- Version: 1.0.31
- Feedback ID: b5efdaad-44b6-4667-93c0-dfecf14e929f
